A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Any2Full. Their complete main texts and appendices, including equations, tables and figures, are readable and support reliable matching across revisions.

before.justification: v1 reports original depth-completion benchmarks, robustness tests, ablations, depth super-resolution results and robotic grasping outcomes.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results and adds a MoGe-2 backbone comparison and further qualitative analyses.

M1.justification: The SAPE architecture, feature modulation and inference pipeline are retained. Appendix C.3 replaces the explicit covariance-based relative-structure loss with averaged local SSIM, but does not establish whether this changes the computation or clarifies the existing loss. Testing MoGe-2 explicitly requires no architectural modification.

E1.justification: Training datasets, six public evaluation datasets, Logistic-Black, depth-pattern coverage, depth super-resolution and warehouse grasping are retained. The added backbone tests and visualizations use existing coverage; point-cloud views analyze depth-completion outputs.

E2.justification: v2 Table 3 adds unadapted MoGe-2-Base as a comparator for Any2Full using that backbone. Existing benchmark comparator sets remain unchanged. CompletionFormer/CompFormer and DepthPrompting/DepthPrompt are naming clarifications.

E3.justification: v2 adds an evaluation configuration using MoGe-2-Base with and without SAPE. Appendix B also changes the stated deformation-rate denominator from grasps to successful grasps. Existing dataset splits, training budgets, resolutions and standard benchmark metrics are retained.

E4.justification: v2 adds a focused backbone-portability test in Table 3 and reconstruction-outlier and irregular-sparsity visual analyses in Figure 7. Additional DIODE and revised KITTI case studies extend the qualitative evidence. Existing component, attention, range and sparsity analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions report 12 paired grasping trials per package-size category and one week of deployment. Neither adds repeated-training-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests.

E6.justification: v2 adds MoGe-2 results and new or replaced qualitative examples. Eight KITTI loss-ablation entries change: for the full objective, Range AbsREL changes from 0.0461 to 0.0587 and Sparse from 0.0216 to 0.0173 (v1 Table 7; v2 Table 8), without a stated setting change. OMNI-DC's prose rank is corrected from 3.5 to 3.4, matching the unchanged Table 1. Main benchmark and sparsity-robustness scores remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Appendix A.1 revises the stated alignment mathematics: v1 describes fitting to metric depth, whereas v2 explicitly fits inverse depth and then applies reciprocal conversion. Appendix C.3 also revises the written relative-structure loss definition. No theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same one-stage, domain-general and pattern-agnostic completion claims, including 32.2% lower average AbsREL than OMNI-DC and a 1.4× speedup over PriorDA.

C2.justification: The loss discussion changes from sensitivity to interpolated LiDAR structure to a smoothness-versus-range-extrapolation tradeoff, explicitly justifying retention of SSIM for downstream structural consistency. v2 also interprets the MoGe-2 results as evidence of backbone generality and qualifies warehouse testing as deployment validation rather than an algorithm comparison.

D1.justification: v2 specifies inverse-depth conversion, normalization over valid pixels and a 3×3 SSIM neighborhood. Appendix B explicitly includes lighting among matched trial conditions but drops v1's two-cell allocation detail. Training hyperparameters, hardware and code/checkpoint access information are otherwise retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds citations to MoGe, MoGe-2 and three logistics/customer-modeling works, with no cited works removed. These extend backbone and deployment context without substantially changing the related-work organization or novelty positioning.

P1.justification: Appendix B is locally rewritten and expanded; alignment, normalization and qualitative-result explanations receive targeted revisions. Range and sparsity discussions are reordered, baseline abbreviations clarified, and author metadata and running headers cleaned up. The overall narrative structure is retained.

P2.justification: v2 adds Table 3 and Figures 7 and 11, replaces the supplementary KITTI sparse-depth examples with 4L/16L examples, and relocates or renumbers retained displays. Tables are compacted, some decimal precision is reduced, and Figure 2's 'Freeze' label is corrected.

improvement.justification: The MoGe-2 comparison strengthens evidence that SAPE works beyond Depth Anything, while added geometric visual checks and clearer disparity-processing details improve assessment and reproducibility. These are limited gains: the SSIM rewrite remains ambiguous, and revised KITTI loss-ablation values are not reconciled with retained module-ablation results. The central benchmark evidence and conclusions remain stable.
